question: Which of the following states Government has unveiled the 'Farmer Registration and Unified beneficiary Information System' (FRUITS), an e-governance portal, to create a repository of farmland information and farm loan details on a single platform?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

Key Points__**

 
• Karnataka government has unveiled the Farmer Registration and Unified beneficiary Information System (FRUITS).
 
• FRUITS is an e-governance portal to create a repository of farmland information and farm loan details on a single platform.
 
• All farmers who will be registered under this will be given an identification number on the portal.
 
• By using this number, banks and other lending institutions can access the land details of farmers as well as details of their existing borrowings and take a quick decision on lending.
